 On a football Tuesdee edition of CBD, former Browns Punter Dave Zastudil joins the show to talk fast starts and how the Browns rebound from Sunday's loss. That plus After Further Review, One thought from every game in week 8 and DT Maliek Collins from the podium!

 On this installment of the Joe Thomas Half Hour the guys talk big matchup game for Harold Fannin Jr., slow starts, and getting the ground game going!

 On this football Friday edition of the program, Z goes one-on-one with HC Todd Monken for an interview on his first game in Pittsburgh as the head coach of the Browns. Steelers play-by-play voice Rob King also joins the show to take you Behind Enemy Lines. Plus, hear TE Harold Fannin Jr from Thursday's coach's show, and get this week's editions of Over/Unders and The Scores.

 On this Thursday edition of the program, the legendary Greg Cosell joins the guys for his weekly Film Review segment of this week's opponent, the Pittsburgh Steelers. Z also goes one-on-one with Browns RB Dylan Sampson for an exclusive interview and gives you his Matchups to watch in Pittsburgh. Plus, hear from DC Mike Rutenberg and DE Jared Verse.

 Browns punting legend Dave Zastudil joins Beau and Z in studio to break down the Browns win over the Titans and to preview Sunday's matchup in Pittsburgh. The guys give you one thought from every week 7 game in the NFL plus Zegura gives us his top four takeaways from win number five in After Further Review!

 On Victory Monday #5 we remember our great friend and the voice of the Browns Jim Donovan on the second anniversary of his passing. Joe Thomas stops by to share his thoughts on Jim, the Browns win and to preview the Steelers game, plus game balls from Coach, soundbites from Coach and Deshaun Watson, the call of the game!

 It's a Football Friday! On this episode, Tyson Campbell sits down with Z and Jerod to talk about the team's culture and the 4-2 start to the season. Titans Senior Writer Jim Wyatt also joins the show to take you behind enemy lines to get a pulse on what's happening in Tennessee. Plus, hear What to Watch, get your Keys to Victory, Over/Unders, and The Scores.
 NOW PLAYING video Matchup with Greg Cosell - 10.22.26 - Cleveland Browns Daily
 On this Thursday edition of the program, the legendary Greg Cosell joins the guys to give his breakdown of the 2027 QB class, break down the film from Week 6's win over the Ravens, and preview this week's matchup with the Titans. You'll also see how we matchup with the Titans and hear from QB Deshaun Watson. Plus, get this week's Fantasy Minute.
 NOW PLAYING video Greg Cosell Film Study WK 7 - 10.22.26 - Cleveland Browns Daily
 On this installment of Greg Cosell's Film Study he breakdowns the hot start for Mike Rutenbergs defense, Cam Ward, and the matchup of Browns and Titans!

 On this First Friday, Z goes one-on-one with Browns TE Harold Fannin Jr to recap the events of the win against Baltimore and more. Browns play-by-play voice Andrew Siciliano also joins the guys to preview this week's game against the Titans. You'll also meet the opponent and get Four Downs with College Football Nate and Uncle Beau.
 NOW PLAYING video After Further Review with Dave Zastudil - - 10.20.26 - Cleveland Browns Daily
 On this Tuesday edition of the program, Browns WR Jerry Jeudy goes one-on-one with Nathan for an exclusive interview on his performance against the Ravens, his role in the offense, and more. Former Browns P Dave Zastudil also joins the guys for this week's edition of Risk vs Reward. You'll also get Nathan's final thoughts on the Baltimore game on After Further Review, hear from HC Todd Monken, and get One Thought on every game in the NFL over the weekend.
